# Release notes

Version **2.0** is *faster*, and ~~not~~ slower. See the [docs](https://example.com/docs?a=1&b=2) or ***both***.

### Details `v2`

snake_case_name and a_b stay readable, but 2\*3\*4 and \[brackets\] and \<tags> and a \\ backslash are escaped.

\# not a heading\
\- not a list\
1\. not numbered\
\> not a quote
